tells.1: Repeated 'Mitigation:' labels make the risk section feel mechanically assembled.
tells.2: Bold thesis statements followed by explanations create an overly uniform, template-driven rhythm.
tells.3: Conversational substitutions feel applied systematically; 'Our people are affected' adds informality without precision.
tells.4: The repeated 'Mitigation:' construction is the clearest remaining formulaic feature.
tells.5: Repeated 'We will' commitments give the risk section a scripted cadence.

reason: Version 4 reads most like a disciplined internal memo: concise, direct, and appropriately professional without conspicuous efforts to sound conversational. These are stylistic judgments, not evidence of authorship; every version still needs financial support and a clearer decision deadline.
